title: Ruthenium-based electrocatalyst for efficient acidic water oxidation in PEM water electrolysis for H2 production
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34991-35002
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05145B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yinan Tao, Ruilin Zhang, Junyan Chen, Wubin Weng, Yong He, Zhihua Wang
The developed Ru6W4Ox showed exceptional OER activity with an overpotential of 140.32 mV at 10 mA cm−2, far superior to commercial RuO2. A PEMWE using Ru6W4Ox achieved 1.784 V at 2 A cm−2, 4.34 kWh m−3 H2 and an electrolysis efficiency of 81.72%.
